headline: On October 30, 1973: Bosphorus Bridge connects Europe and Asia
captionCards: Vital for transportation and economic ties today
instagramCaption:
The Bosphorus Bridge in Turkey is completed.
 
On October 30, 1973, the Bosphorus Bridge, officially known as the 15 July Martyrs Bridge, was completed, connecting Ortaköy in Europe to Beylerbeyi in Asia. This bridge, the second to span the Bosphorus, became a vital link between the two continents. It remains the oldest and southernmost of the three suspension bridges over the Bosphorus. The bridge's construction significantly improved transportation and economic ties between the two continents.
